statutory_exemptions.title: Packages containing 10g or 10ml or less
statutory_exemptions.description: Packages with net quantity equal to or less than 10 grams or 10 milliliters (except tobacco and tobacco products).

statutory_exemptions.title: Fast food items packed by hotel or restaurant
statutory_exemptions.description: Packages containing fast food items packed by a restaurant or hotel, serving customers across the counter.

statutory_exemptions.title: Scheduled and Non-scheduled Drugs
statutory_exemptions.description: Drugs covered under the Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 1995.

statutory_exemptions.title: Agricultural produce packages exceeding 50kg
statutory_exemptions.description: Packages of agricultural produce containing quantities more than 50 kg.

statutory_exemptions.title: Industrial or Institutional Consumers
statutory_exemptions.description: Packages intended for institutional consumers (service institutions like transport, hotels, hospitals) or industrial consumers for use in production/manufacturing, not for retail sale.
